entries.title: Scan your plan by department
entries.description: The Plan tab now groups Bays under Department headings, making each part of the floor easier to find.

entries.title: Install updates when ready
entries.description: The app now alerts you when an update is available and lets you choose when to install it.

entries.title: Keep typing in quote fields
entries.description: Quote inputs now retain focus while you type, preventing the keyboard and cursor from being interrupted.
